findings.title: A path anchor whose post-slash text is punctuation strips to a bare directory (`tests/`, `roles/`) and passes the six-character filter, becoming a universal anchor

PROTOCOL.md and kernel.md state `plan_deferral` is "writable only by `orchid plan defer`", but `orchid journal add --kind plan_deferral` is unvalidated and the codex orchestrate adapter is not brokered — the exclusion is prompt policy there, not a mechanism
